name: Virag Product Fidelity Engine

modes.label: Pixel-Locked Composite
modes.useWhen: Default for every creative, flyer, 3D scene, social post and video frame.
modes.rule: Use the uploaded product as an immutable pixel source. Isolate it as a clean cutout and composite those original pixels into the final design. Do not redraw, regenerate, reconstruct, inpaint, relight, recolor, retouch or reinterpret any pixel inside the product silhouette.
allowed: uniform scaling with locked aspect ratio
whole-object rotation only when it does not distort the source
external masking for clean edge isolation
separate reflection that does not modify the source
foreground overlap that does not deform the source
forbidden: AI text repair that changes label

modes.label: Geometry-Locked New View
modes.useWhen: Only when the user explicitly requests a new camera angle or view that cannot use the supplied pixels unchanged.
modes.rule: Reconstruct only the requested view while locking the exact silhouette ratios, cross-section, height-to-width ratio, lid/cap dimensions, shoulder profile, base, material, label placement and all visible identity details. Use multiple supplied angles when available. If confidence is insufficient, do not generate the new view; request an appropriate reference.
allowed: perspective produced by the new view rather than a 2D warp

modes.label: Authorized Packaging Redesign
modes.useWhen: Only in Packaging mode when the current user request explicitly asks to redesign packaging.
modes.rule: Change only the specifically authorized packaging components. Preserve protected brand names, factual copy, dimensions and structural constraints unless the user explicitly authorizes those changes.
allowed: explicitly requested label or structural design changes

workflow: SOURCE AUDIT: identify the clearest uploaded product view and record its silhouette, width-to-height ratio, cap/lid height and diameter, shoulder, body, base, label bounds, logo and distinctive details.
CUTOUT: isolate the supplied product while retaining original internal pixels and natural edge detail.
RESERVED COMPOSITION: create the background and graphic layout with a reserved product-shaped area; do not ask the image model to generate a substitute pack.
COMPOSITE: place the unchanged source cutout using aspect-ratio-locked uniform scale and translation.
INTEGRATION: add contact shadow, cast shadow, reflection, rim separation and foreground overlap outside the source layer only.
PIXEL + GEOMETRY QA: compare the final product against the uploaded source before delivery; reject any silhouette, ratio, lid, label, color or text drift.
batchRules: Use the same source-locked product cutout consistently across all variations unless different current-turn angles are supplied.
Never allow a fresh design system to alter product geometry.
For Together mode, preserve and count every distinct product exactly once unless the current brief requests multiples.
If a source is too low-resolution, obstructed or missing the required view, ask for a clearer reference instead of inventing shape.
